claim: SK hynix states that after its VEU status was revoked effective 31 December 2025, BIS granted it in December 2025 an annual licence for 2026 allowing approved US-origin equipment to be shipped to its China facilities without case-by-case licences.
evidence: "In lieu of the VEU framework, the BIS implemented an annual approval mechanism under which we are required to submit yearly plans detailing our anticipated needs for U.S.-origin equipment." "In December 2025, the BIS granted us an annual license for 2026, allowing approved U.S.-origin equipment to be shipped to our facilities in China and removing the burden of obtaining case-by-case export licenses during such year." (SK hynix Form 424B4, risk factors on export controls)
notes: Context for CLM-0899, CLM-0901 and CLM-0902 (fact-check fc-W1-c9f0). Press reports say Samsung received a similar 2026 annual licence; not confirmed against a primary source.
